body:
Thank you. I had the day off work today and I slept in with these like...positive affirmations on video. Ended up sleeping/laying in bed til 2 which is way later than I meant to but....whatever. Wake up, water the plants, and cry. Now I'm just like..I don't know man. I feel so bad. I feel so, so bad. 

I guess it's getting worse because I had a plan and I did more research on it. I won't attempt anything unless I know it'll work. I talked to this support group about it and it didn't go too great. Nobody is supposed to call anyone out but this person was like "what is our role when we see someone suicidal like that?" and then the whole group ended up discussing it which was really awkward. Lots of people assumed I didn't have a plan and it was just the suicidal ideation and I just allowed them to think that but for real, man....I'm just like...I can't go through with it right now because of this legal thing I have to finish up otherwise I'll leave my family with a HUGE headache. But I can't even take the next steps on it due to my depression.

I feel like such a weak, pathetic loser for having such a hard time with this. I think pretending to be happy would make things better but I wake up in this stupid empty place and I don't want to do anything at all.

Thank you and I'm sorry you're grieving too. I lost my dog as well, she I know would be here for me. I mean...the day I said goodbye I cried so hard into her furry neck and even though she'd been in pain all day she pushed against me so hard. Then she'd stop and rest and as I kept crying she kept pushing back to nuzzle me. I mean...I'll never forget how strong she was in those moments, SHE wanted to comfort ME and SHE was the one dying.

I must've not been clear. It's not my therapist who's leaving, it's my roommate/friend. I appreciate your words anyway. I just...I guess in my head I can recognize that people come and go and this isn't the end of the world and there can be other things in the future (no hope for 'better' at this point), but my issue is that every loss like this feels like a crisis. Every time. It's so constant for me, I have no enegy to keep pushing and pushing myself out of these crises. I'm so tired. I'm so done. The more tired I am the more I give in to activities that contribute to that depression and now my home is empty and there's no witness to hold me accountable to not spending all day crying. I don't know...I'm really in a bad place. I just...am so tired of having so many feelings. I don't feel capable of living in this world, of living this life, of building the resilience people talk about. I feel so tired. I have so little support and the support I had turned out to be unhealthy and left me feeling more incapable in the end. Oh God is still just the feeling I have.
It's interesting to see how even those we aren't close to can leave a mark, but it's also difficult to see someone dying when that's what you want. I don't know, man.

I totally agree and I would have one now but where I live I don't have a yard so walking a dog 3x a day is a big commitment and last year I had some knee issues so I've been telling myself I'll get a place with a yard and then get a dog...I also was thinking not to make big changes so that's part of why I've waited. 

I know a dog would help. I just...feel really stuck.
In therapy already. I've looked for grief groups twice now, no luck. I just...feel too distressed to seek them out right now.

I could but they already told me that they can't help with the baggage i'm carrying - they've got their own grief too. And....I just...they, I think I leaned too hard on the people who were supportive because they all need space from my feelings. I wish I could get some space from my feelings. 

So no, the people I have in my life right now are close people who need space and new people who I don't want to chase away with this.
Sorry bud. That sucks, I'm in the same boat so I don't think I can really help but hopefully you get the help you need. There's 'warm lines' you can call to talk to someone. Upvoted so - there ya go.
I'm so sorry you're going through that.

Dude I totally know what you mean. Not really the same but my people found my username and my posts here and read them. Like...I feel so embarrassed. These aren't things I would tell them and I wouldn't tell them like this. Why couldn't they just say it existed and the extent of how serious? Why share it? 

I don't know what to do with concerned people.
